caption:
The blank page triggers the same analysis paralysis you feel everywhere else — too many options, no clear best one, so your brain chooses nothing. The First Line removes the decision entirely. You don't choose what to write. You write what's already there. DM "JOURNAL" for the full 7-Day Overthinking Detox. Save this for the next freeze.

#journaling #overthinking #anxiety #decisionparalysis #arajournals
hook: you opened your journal. stared at the page. closed it.
